visibilityPredicate.rule: a scored cell is visible iff no intermediate terrain cell (the nearest cell centre to each 0.25 m sample) exceeds the sight line by more than 1e-9
visibilityPredicate.scope: every valid cell is scored, the observer's own cell included; a NoData cell is neither a target nor a blocker and is left out of both counts
visibilityPredicate.noDataTreatment: NoData intermediate cells do not block and NoData targets are not counted

expectation: the wall block hides a contiguous band behind it; a run that reports the whole grid as visible has not evaluated occlusion at all
